# Automating 3D Asset Import in Roblox with Claude and Open Cloud APIs

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dd4_kY-StGS/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** cuhfilme · **Saved:** 2026-09-30

**Why I saved it:** Roblox game dev

## Summary

The creator demonstrates how to automate importing 3D assets into Roblox using Claude and Blender. By configuring a Roblox Open Cloud API key with asset read and write permissions and providing it via an environment variable, Claude can automatically upload and place assets directly into the game.
